name: Mitten Extracts | 2g Disposable | Slurricane
description: Heavy, fruity, and full of flavor, Slurricane is an indica that means business. Sweet berry notes meet a slow-building relaxation that hits like a storm rolling in. This 2g disposable is all about melting tension, easing stress, and helping you sink into a calmer state of mind. Rich, flavorful clouds make every hit satisfying, while the effects remind you why Indica's reign supreme for winding down.
